description: Zombies carry wooden doors as shields, weapons, and shelter from sunlight. Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.1.2.

mods.name: Zombie Doors
mods.description: Zombies break, carry, and fight with wooden doors, blocking projectiles and sheltering from sunlight.

releases.notes:
Zombie Doors 0.3.1 for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric).

Accept older Fabric Loader and Fabric API versions. The door, combat, biome, and modded-wood features from 0.3.0 are included.

Minimum requirements: Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.3, and Fabric API 0.160.6+26.3. Newer Fabric versions are allowed; use an API build for Minecraft 26.3. Other mods may require newer dependencies.

Install `zombie-doors-0.3.1+mc26.3.jar` on the server and each client. The `-sources.jar` contains the code; the Source code ZIP/TAR contains the complete buildable project.

Optional configuration screen: Cloth Config 26.3.158 and Mod Menu 21.0.0-beta.1.

Fix a startup crash caused by the removed drowning-conversion method. Converting zombies drop their doors before becoming drowned.

Packaged client startup, door rendering and synchronization, and conversion/drop checks passed with the minimum Fabric versions above.

Known Minecraft 26.3 issue on some high-core Windows systems: native renderer startup can crash even without Zombie Doors. Adding `-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=4` to the launcher’s JVM arguments worked around it on the affected machine.
